US Natural Gas Prices Rise Amid Heatwave and Demand Forecasts

US natural gas futures saw an increase due to forecasts of hotter weather and anticipated cooling demand. The price movement reflects market reactions to expected weather patterns and their impact on energy consumption. This trend indicates a sensitivity of natural gas prices to seasonal temperature variations and their influence on the energy market.
